title: Editorial proof
idea: Editorial proof: One concrete proposition faces a large source-backed example, followed by a compact interpretation.
audience: People who need to assess claim within a marketing surface.
worksWellWhen: Visitors need confidence in a specific claim rather than a broad feature list.
avoidWhen: There is no evidence supporting the proposition.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic editorial layout through its assess claim priority and explicit commitment contract: Distinguish observed evidence from sample content and future capability.
navigation: Editorial proof keeps the current assess claim context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: One concrete proposition faces a large source-backed example, followed by a compact interpretation.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to assess claim; visitors need confidence in a specific claim rather than a broad feature list.
composition.priority: Distinguish observed evidence from sample content and future capability.

imagery.role: Support the actual assess claim context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep the proposition and its first proof adjacent at phone width.
Use a legible phone reading order; media never blocks the primary proposition.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the editorial proof structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no assess claim content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Distinguish observed evidence from sample content and future capability.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized assess claim content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Distinguish observed evidence from sample content and future capability.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active assess claim context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure initial transfer, layout stability and real image decode cost at the chosen device.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate with browser study renders. Automated browser checks are recorded in evals/specimen-review.json. No independent visual comparison, task study or native runtime verification; remains draft. The illustration/task content demonstrates composition and does not prescribe every linked palette or font.
